$comment: Phase-0 catalog spec for the Confetti mobile (Compose Material 3) sheet. Code-led: the render is authoritative. Modelled on the Confetti conference app (joreilly/confetti) — the stickers reproduce its signature surfaces (session cards, the bookmark toggle, speaker rows, the schedule scaffold) in standalone material3, plus the per-conference brand themes the app derives from each conference's themeColor seed. Primary modes are the M3 light/dark pair. A component's `variants` fold extra state renders (bookmarked/off) onto the same sticker.
title: Confetti (Mobile Material 3)

components.caption: The signature session row — bold title, speakers, and room, with the bookmark toggle.

variants.caption: Bookmarked — the ribbon fills and tints to primary.

components.caption: A lightning-talk session — the primaryContainer bolt pill above the title.
A break row — title + time span, no room and no bookmark.
The bookmark toggle — the outlined add-bookmark ribbon.
The sticky section header — a clock icon + time between two dividers.
The lightning-talk pill on its own — a primaryContainer capsule with the bolt.
A speaker row — 64dp circular avatar, name, tagline.
A speaker grid cell — 150dp rounded avatar over the centred name.
The schedule day tabs — one tab per conference day.
The bottom navigation — Schedule, Speakers, Bookmarks, Venue.
The rounded search field — leading magnifier, trailing clear, no indicator line.
The default Confetti purple brand, applied to a session card + token swatches.
Re-branded from Android Makers' amber seed (#E59A4F).
The full schedule screen — CenterAlignedTopAppBar, day tabs, time header, session rows, break, and bottom nav, on a phone with system chrome.
